title: Fridge Compartment Sensor Error
shortDescription: The refrigerator temperature sensor has malfunctioned.
fullDescription: E1 on Godrej refrigerators indicates the fresh food compartment sensor is reading outside expected range.

fixSteps.title: Power cycle
fixSteps.instruction: Unplug 5 minutes. Use voltage stabilizer when reconnecting.

fixSteps.title: Locate sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Near air duct inside fridge. Check connector.

whenToCallPro: If sensor fine but error persists.
videoSearchQuery: Godrej refrigerator E1 error sensor fix

title: Freezer Sensor Error
shortDescription: The freezer temperature sensor has malfunctioned.
fullDescription: E2 indicates the freezer sensor is reading abnormally.
whenToCallPro: If sensor fine but error persists.
videoSearchQuery: Godrej refrigerator E2 error freezer sensor fix

title: Defrost Heater Error
shortDescription: The defrost heater is not functioning.
fullDescription: E3 indicates the defrost heater or thermostat has failed.
videoSearchQuery: Godrej refrigerator E3 error defrost fix

title: Compressor Start Error
fullDescription: E4 indicates the compressor did not start within expected time.

fixSteps.title: Check voltage
fixSteps.instruction: Verify 220-240V. Voltage stabilizer essential in India.

fixSteps.title: Test start relay
fixSteps.instruction: Pull off compressor. Shake for rattling. Test continuity.

videoSearchQuery: Godrej refrigerator E4 error compressor start fix

faq.a: Helps protect compressor from low voltage damage.

title: Evaporator Fan Error
shortDescription: The evaporator fan motor has failed.
fullDescription: E5 indicates the evaporator fan is not running.

fixSteps.title: Check for ice
fixSteps.instruction: Open freezer. Check for ice around fan.

videoSearchQuery: Godrej refrigerator E5 error fan fix

faq.a: Fan distributes cold air to both.

title: Communication Error
shortDescription: Main and display board communication failure.
fullDescription: E6 indicates communication fault between boards.
videoSearchQuery: Godrej refrigerator E6 error communication fix

title: Evaporator Sensor Error
shortDescription: The evaporator coil temperature sensor has malfunctioned.
fullDescription: E7 indicates the evaporator sensor is returning abnormal readings, affecting defrost timing.
whenToCallPro: If defrost system has other failures.
videoSearchQuery: Godrej refrigerator E7 error evaporator sensor fix

title: Door Alarm Error
shortDescription: A door has been left open too long.
fullDescription: E8 indicates a door is open or the door switch is faulty.

fixSteps.title: Check gasket
fixSteps.instruction: Look for gaps. Clean with warm water.

whenToCallPro: Only if hinge needs major work.
videoSearchQuery: Godrej refrigerator E8 error door alarm fix

faq.a: Dollar bill test. If slides out, replace.
